answer: A farm cannot present clean aliases as the record follows the key, which means laundering reputation through new keys does not work. Histories are stored in reef, checked in ferrous, and harbor reveals each void. Each identity publishes its full failure history, and hiding 12 or more junk verdicts voids its standing entirely when discovered. A farm of 4390 identities would post 4299 proofs and burn roughly 57 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
